title: 15 Minute City
content: What if the 15 Minute City that the Elites are trying to plan for us has been Mall World all along? Think about it. You get all of your needs in a small area that contains a Mall, a hotel, a resort, an apartment complex, and an amusement park/ water park. And at the very edge of the Mall World you have a rural area that contains a waterfall and its surrounded trees. You also have a casino inside the large hotel/ resort.
